message.content: The Skeptic's claims c1 and c2 align with my model, but my earlier risk_map contained an incorrect worst-case |z| figure (0.535, which would only occur if the halved mantissa could exceed 1.65 — it cannot, since pre-halving mantissa is capped just under 2.0 by the bit pattern... actually [1,2) pre-halving, so post-halving [1,1)∪[1,1) — no: pre-halving mantissa ∈ [1,2), halved when >1.65, so post-reduction mantissa ∈ [1,1.65)∪[0.5,0.825]. Wait, that matters: if the raw mantissa is in [1,1.65] it stays; if in (1.65,2) it becomes (0.825,1). So the reduced mantissa lies in [0.825, 1.65], and |z| ≤ max at 1.65 giving 0.2453, and at 0.825 giving |z|=(1-0.825)/1.825≈0.0959. So z ∈ [-0.096, 0.245], confirming c1's z≈0.245 bound.) I'll record a focused correction so the Experimenter has accurate probe targets.

message.reasoning_content: My description model is already recorded. Skeptic raised c1 and c2. I can refine the description with sharpened analysis of the reachable z-range and coefficient/truncation error budgets to help the Experimenter. Key refinement: mantissa after reduction ∈ [1, 1.65], so |z| ≤ (1.65-1)/2.65 ≈ 0.2453 (also for values near 0.5*1.65... actually un-halved branch mantissa ∈ [1,1.65]; halved branch also [1,1.65). But wait — mantissa can be as low as 1.0, z ≥ 0; so z ∈ [0, 0.2453]. My earlier risk_map note about z up to 0.535 was wrong; correct it. Also correction term handles u rounding. Record a small refinement update.
